unit: independently generated root run; group every restart, treatment twin, derived variant, clean/noisy export and shared checkpoint with its root
normal: verified event-free schedule including pressure and compressor operating transients

labels.LEAK: independently recorded withdrawal location, onset/end and signed flow; physical leak label requires demonstrated mechanism
labels.FAULT: documented source-supported actuator or component deviation and actual response
labels.DELAY: logged command, actuator response, nominal latency and independently measured excess delay

allocation.development: all four labels across independent roots, with recorded source profiles and known candidate location truth
allocation.calibration: separate roots, all four labels and location coverage where calibrated; freeze score mapping and abstention thresholds before test
allocation.untouched_test: separate roots and operators or source lineage when practicable; reserve a profile condition and topology for subsequent separate transfer arms
allocation.coverage_rule: each required label and localization region must have independent coverage in every partition where evaluated; minimum coverage is an admission rule, not a precision guarantee
allocation.planning_rule: pre-register target precision and operational error budgets with domain owners; derive family counts from design, dependence and pilot variability before confirmatory testing

design.controls: matched normal and interventions allowed within a root; group together
design.purpose: four-class support, false alarms, event delay, location candidate comparison

design.experiment: Independent source-model discrepancy and instrumentation qualification
Independent pressure, flow and boundary regimes with qualified gas properties
Untouched topology transfer and external reference runs
design.purpose: test new topology separately; document sensor-role remapping or retraining

metrics.detection: fixed causal clock; positive opens episode, first negative resets; credit only new starts during verified event; counts, inactive hours, missed events and delay quantiles
metrics.diagnosis: macro F1, per-class counts and confidence intervals over independent roots conditional on class support
metrics.calibration: calibration only on disjoint roots; reliability and Brier/log loss on untouched class-supported cases
metrics.selective_risk: paired same observations; choose coverage targets and confidence rule in calibration; report denominator and uncertainty at attained matched nonzero coverage
metrics.localization: conditional on supported leak, score against source-time location; preserve configured versus inferred distinctions
metrics.formal: validated predictive enclosures; report every hypothesis status and unresolved cases

formal_required.measurement: per-channel physical units, bias, repeatability, resolution, timestamp synchronization, clock uncertainty and dropout state, with traceable coverage and applicable ranges
formal_required.initial_and_boundary: admissible initial states and control trajectories conditioned on independently recorded settings and their uncertainties
formal_required.model_discrepancy: independent matched physical/reference data across intended conditions, separated from measurement and numerical error; correlated error and validity domain documented
formal_required.numerical: convergence and event handling used as numerical evidence with justified verified enclosures when available
formal_required.prediction: source-compatible adapter maps feasible initial/boundary/parameter/gas sets to simultaneous sensor-and-time enclosures for each hypothesis, including model discrepancy; verify no excluded true states within declared domain
formal_required.current: Hypothetical stresses and fixed threshold boxes are exploratory; qualified uncertainty unavailable. Preserve INDETERMINATE, UNRESOLVED and L0.
